family: Repository-independent utilities, local Merge admission and isolated executable metadata
implementation: Typed About, Help, rtfm, autotext test, update check and first-start CLI/URL handlers avoid unrelated Git configuration restoration and new saved-access/Finder-watch initialization.
Empty-path Settings URLs admit the global property sheet; captured-path Settings including CLI current-directory default retain Git readiness. Earlier queued Git requests retain FIFO ownership.

Local Merge Open/two-way/three-way admit captured local readers and bundled MergeDiff without initial Git configuration restoration; Git-target patch review and Git diff --no-index generation retain preparation.
About and engine Settings use explicit GitRepository.executableVersion; generic run always retains preparation, including ordinary --version/raw argument/executor override forms.

Metadata execution reuses existing cancellable process/output/drain ownership, uses its fresh owned temporary directory, neutralizes merged Git configuration/repository context and skips SSH preference/prompt resolution.

initial_core_failure.repair: Restore unconditional generic-run preparation; expose only the isolated executableVersion API and switch the two native consumers.
